newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Gulf Bank can buy 10 pct of own shares.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Bank can buy 10 pct of own shares.

text.p: Kuwait's Central Bank has permitted Gulf Bank to buy up to 10 percent of its own shares at a maximum value of 25 million dinars ($83.6 million) over six months, the official Kuwait News Agency reported on Tuesday.
"The Central Bank of Kuwait announced today (Tuesday) its approval of Gulf Bank buying of no more than 10 percent of its shares within (a total value) of 25 million dinars," it said.
The bank said the shares should be bought at the market price at the time of each transaction over a six-month span as of the time the bank is notified of the approval, it said.
Gulf Bank shares closed at 540 fils on Tuesday. There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.
Total Gulf Bank subscribed shares amount to 781.7 million.
Gulf Bank, established in 1960, made a net profit rise to 15.3 million dinars in the first six months of 1996 compared to 12.3 million in the same period of 1995.
